title: The Morning Digest: November 15, 2026
dek: Iran's navy and the IRGC said three tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, one in the eastern strait in the morning and two in the southern strait in the evening, one described as a supertanker (Reuters, Nov 14). Reuters could not verify the reports and UKMTO had not confirmed them, and no vessel is named in either statement. Brent Jan27 settled at $95.84 on Friday, up $0.02, and WTI Dec26 settled at $88.56, down $0.18, taking the Brent to WTI spread to $7.28. Sunday Nov 15 is the target date for binding Pathways agreements and the grandfathering line for Alberta's Oil Sands Growth Program, and no signing had been announced as of Sunday morning. December WCS is -$28.27 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 13) on zero lots. The validated diesel crack is $90.30.
